sections.h2: Six lists bar 5,417 DPSU items from import, most of them in the first list

chart.title: Item count per list is set by how finely a parts list was cut
chart.sub: Items barred from import, per notified Positive Indigenisation List.
chart.source: Dept. of Defence Production, PIB PRID 1924426, 2033571, 2300723.

sections.means: Item counts track how finely a parts list was cut, not how much capability moved onshore.
sections.todo: Publish the value of each list so the later, harder lists can be judged on money.

sections.h2: The ministry's two releases give ₹94 lakh and ₹114 lakh per item for the same lists

chart.title: The same four lists carry two substitution values in two releases
chart.sub: Import substitution value per indigenised item, ₹ lakh, PILs 1–4.
chart.source: Ministry of Defence via PIB, PRID 1924426 (May 2023) and 2033571 (July 2024).

sections.means: The ministry's May 2023 and July 2024 releases report different substitution values for the identical four-list scope.
sections.todo: Reconcile the two releases and state which figure is current.

sections.h2: Even the largest reading of the lists is under 2 per cent of one year's output

chart.title: Against one year's production, the lists and ADITI are small
chart.source: MoD via PIB, 17 June 2026; shares computed in the original post.

sections.means: Against a single year's production the lists and ADITI are small, though the ratio mixes cumulative and annual figures.
